note: MIXED PAGE: three columns headed ELEMENTARY | MIDDLE | HIGH (line 41) under 'SCHOOL STAFF' (line 40). The page names no school; it holds 6 elementary, 7 middle and 6 high entries, so the page is filed under the middle school, recorded as turkey-hill because its principal is Mary Cringan, named Turkey Hill Middle School principal in the 1991 report (page 62). Because the page-level school cannot carry three schools, each entry's grade_or_dept starts with its column's printed heading (ELEMENTARY:, MIDDLE:, HIGH:) followed by the section label above it. Lines 1-39 are the end of the high school principal's narrative: ignored. Lines 42, 44 and 46 are rows of title labels (PRINCIPAL, ASST. PRINCIPAL, ADMIN. SECRETARY) and the names under the first two are recorded with that title as role_raw; the ADMIN. SECRETARY row on line 46 is followed by no names at all (the next row is PRE-SCHOOL | GRADE 5 | BUSINESS), so no secretary is recorded. Lines 49 and 50 each carry a section heading in one column (KINDERGARTEN, INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY) beside names in the others, so they appear in both headings and entries. 'Mary 8. Cringan' (line 43) is kept as printed; the 8 is a misread E. The three columns continue on page 22.
